Saveetha School of Law vs Saveetha University for integrated law compares recorded year fees and 2023 placements. The university also has a NIRF Law rank from 2023, which is not a 2025 rank.

sections.heading: Saveetha School of Law vs Saveetha University for integrated law: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Treat this as a comparison of two recorded profiles that may sit in the same university group, not as two unrelated private colleges. Confirm which legal entity and which campus will issue your degree.

Saveetha School of Law has a recorded year total fee of ₹2.75 lakh for BA LLB, BBA LLB, B.Com LLB and B.Sc. LLB, and a 2023 row with an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹11 lakh. Saveetha University has recorded BA LLB / BBA LLB tuition of ₹1.60 lakh a year plus a facilities fee of ₹60,000 a year, a 2023 row with an average of ₹9 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh, and a NIRF Law 2023 rank of 11.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show
paragraphs: Saveetha School of Law has recorded Total Fees of ₹2.75 lakh a year across the integrated law programmes on this page. Treat this as a recorded year fee, not a confirmed five-year total, until you check the official circular.

Saveetha University has two recorded year heads for BA LLB and BBA LLB: tuition of ₹1.60 lakh and a facilities fee of ₹60,000. This page lists those heads separately and does not add them into an invented annual total. Confirm the official payable amount for the current year.

sections.heading: Placements and rank compared
paragraphs: School of Law's recorded 2023 figures are an average package of ₹4 lakh and a highest package of ₹11 lakh, listed against B.Com LLB (Hons). University-side recorded 2023 figures are an average of ₹9 lakh and a highest of ₹12 lakh, listed against BA LLB (Hons). These are historical outcomes, not a salary promise.
Saveetha University has a NIRF Law rank of 11 from 2023 in our records. That is not a NIRF 2025 rank, and this page does not treat it as current until you check the latest NIRF list.

sections.heading: Admission and eligibility
paragraphs: Both sides have CLAT listed in our records on this page. Confirm on the official admissions notice whether admission is through CLAT, a university test, or both.
Integrated law programmes are typically five-year courses after Class 12. Read the official eligibility for the exact programme, such as BA LLB or BBA LLB.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Saveetha School of Law is listed at Seneerkuppam / Thiruverkadu Road, Chennai. Saveetha University is listed at Saveetha Nagar, Thandalam, Chennai.
These are different recorded addresses. Confirm the teaching campus for the programme you want, especially if the two names belong to the same group.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: First confirm whether you are applying to one school inside the Saveetha / SIMATS group or to two separate admissions processes. The recorded names can look like a choice between related institutions.

If you are comparing the recorded 2023 packages, the university-side row is higher, at an average of ₹9 lakh, and it also has a 2023 NIRF Law rank of 11. If you are comparing the recorded year total fee on the School of Law side, that figure is ₹2.75 lakh a year.
Confirm official 2026-27 fees and the latest placement report before you decide.
